summary: FC-DMS10 系列智能电子哨兵是一款集多种高灵敏度传感器、精密控制模块、指向性警示装置及尖端 AI 智能算法于一体的轻型、多功能智能化探测设备。该系统专门设计用于野外及要地周边环境，可实现 24/7 全天候侦察监视、实时态势感知与安全预警。其探警一体化的设计融合了星光级超低照度成像与主动警示功能（包括高音喇叭与爆闪灯），配合轻便、高强度的准球形抗风结构，是战术部署、要地防御与移动哨位监控的理想选择。
summary_en: The FC-DMS10 Series Smart Electronic Sentinel is a lightweight, multi-functional, and intelligent detection system that integrates a variety of high-sensitivity sensors, precision control modules, directional warning devices, and advanced AI algorithms. Specifically designed for field and perimetry environments, this system enables 24/7 all-weather reconnaissance, real-time situational awareness, and early security warnings. Its 'detect-and-alert' integrated architecture combines starlight ultra-low-light imaging with active deterrent features (including high-decibel speakers and strobe lights). Coupled with a portable, high-strength quasi-spherical wind-resistant structure, it serves as an ideal solution for tactical deployment, critical infrastructure defense, and mobile sentry monitoring.
key_application: 应用领域：FC-DMS10 系列智能电子哨兵；探警一体化设计，集成探测与主动驱离模块；适用于边境、营区及临时哨位的全天候快速监控部署。
key_application_en: Integrated detection and deterrent warning system; all-weather surveillance with starlight ultra-low-light imaging; ultra-stable quasi-spherical design for high-wind environments; portable tactical deployment (≤10kg).
key_parameter_1: 传感器: 背照式超低照度星光级 CMOS
key_parameter_2: 旋转范围: 水平 360° 连续旋转；俯仰 -90° ～ +90°

parameters.可见光成像: 1920×1080 分辨率，47倍光学变倍，星光级最低照度 (0.0001Lux)
parameters.警示功能: 集成高音喇叭 + 爆闪灯，支持自定义音频报警及激光眩目警示
parameters.激光模块: 高清泛光匀化光源，照射距离 1000 米，照明角度 1°～20°
parameters.云台性能: 水平/俯仰速度可达 100°/s，支持 3000 个预置位，准球形防抖机身
parameters.通信/网络: 1路 RJ45 以太网口（可选配 4G/5G 模块），供电 DC12V-36V
parameters.环境能力: 工作温度 -40℃～60℃，具备 IP67 高级别防护能力
parameters.智能算法: 支持热点告警、目标自动寻找与锁定跟踪、PHM 健康管理
parameters.定制化: 支持自定义功能开发与 OEM 深度定制

parameters_en.Optical Sensor: 1080P Starlight CMOS; 47x Optical Zoom + 16x Digital Zoom; Min Illumination 0.0001 Lux
parameters_en.Deterrent Modules: Integrated high-decibel speaker and strobe sirens; supports custom voice recordings
parameters_en.Laser Illuminator: HD homogenized floodlight source; 1000m range; 1° to 20° beam angle
parameters_en.PTZ Dynamics: Pan: 360° continuous; Tilt: -90° to +90°; Precise tracking speed 0.01° to 100°/s
parameters_en.Connectivity: RJ45 Ethernet with optional 4G/5G wireless; supports DC12V-36V power input
parameters_en.AI Intelligence: Target detection & tracking; Hot-spot warning; PHM health management system
parameters_en.Durability: IP67 rated; Operating temperature: -40°C to 60°C; Humidity ≤95%
parameters_en.Expansion: Supports customized software modules and specialized forensic tools

detail_html:
功能特点

  • 多光谱环境适应力：结合超低照度可见光与激光夜视，不仅能在暗光下高清成像，还能通过补光穿透暗视障。
  • 探驱联动响应：在侦测到非法入侵后，系统可立即触发声光强力干扰，将“发现即驱离”落到实处。
  • 卓越的机动部署性：整机重量控制在 10kg 以内，单兵可快速安装在三脚架或楼顶边缘，极简布线。
  • 全方位动态视角：采用准球形外壳，有效降低高空风载导致的画面抖动，确保超长焦下的图像稳定。
  • 智能化哨位管理：具备设备自主巡航、多目标接续跟踪及运行状态 PHM 自动诊查，降低后勤压力。
  • 野外恶劣工况保障：IP67 级别浸泡式防水与超宽温设计，满足从极寒戈壁到高热海岛的实战需求。
  • Figure 1 Smart Electronic Sentinel
detail_html_en:
Features

  • Multi-Spectral Resilience: pairs starlight-grade sensors with laser illumination to maintain HD clarity in zero-lux conditions and light foliage.
  • Detect & Deter Synergy: once an intruder is identified, the system instantly engages sirens and strobes, enabling immediate passive defense on the front line.
  • Tactical Mobility: weighing under 10kg, the unit can be rapidly deployed by a single technician on tripods or temporary structures with minimal cabling.
  • Vibration-Free Vigilance: the quasi-spherical shell geometry minimizes wind drag/buffeting, ensuring stable imagery even at maximum telephoto zoom.
  • Autonomous Surveillance: features smart cruising, sequential multi-target tracking, and onboard PHM diagnostics to minimize human oversight requirements.
  • Rugged Sentry Performance: IP67-rated immersion-proofing and an extreme temperature range ensure operational reliability from the tundra to tropical coastlines.
